Package org.tmt.aps.peas.common

Utility classes for managing coordinate data, lists of coordinates, encoding coordinates lists to and from string formats that are used to store coordinate lists in a database; the package also contains utilities for generating messages using resource bundles and utilities for generating error and success messages for all cases in PEAS (record update, procedure execution, command execution and generic).

See: Description

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    FloatListEncoder
    Utility functions to encode and decode lists and one and two dimensional arrays of floating point numbers to a string representation.
    FloatPoint
    A floating point coordinate class.
    FloatPointListEncoder
    Utility functions to encode and decode lists of FloatPoints from a string representation to Lists and Arrays.
    IntegerListEncoder
    Utility functions to encode and decode lists and arrays of integer numbers to a string representation.
    IterationListEncoder
    Utility functions to encode and decode IterationLists from a string representation to Lists and Arrays.
    MessageGenerator
    Utility class to generate messsages using the resource bundle 'messages.properties'
    Point
    An integer point coordinate class.
    PointListEncoder
    Utility functions to encode and decode lists of Points from a string representation to Lists and Arrays.
    Rect
    A rectangle represented by two points
    RectListEncoder
    Utility functions to encode and decode lists of Rects from a string representation to Lists.
    TriState
    Class representing a three-state logical.
    Utils
    General Utilities for PEAS PCS: includes static functions for generating exception messages for screen display and logging, Futures waiting, Thread sleeping and data formatting for viewable output.
